completeness.why: All four category-selecting actions take the income and hidden rules from shouldFillCategory (copyPreviousMonth via filterFillCategories on its own budget rows, the others via getFillCategories) with an explicit hiddenRule argument naming the preserved variation; the hidden SQL filters are gone from the sites; both sign inversions call averageToBudgetAmount.

interface.why: A single hiddenRule parameter carries the real variation and makes the setZero and missing-group inconsistencies explicit and documented, with no speculative options; the 'skip' vs 'skip-unless-visible' names are a bit opaque about the missing-group difference they encode.
